prompt: A cramped attic bedroom at night, seen from a lens fixed high in the corner where the sloped ceiling meets the wall, looking down at a single bed under the eaves. Brandon sits on the edge of the bed typing on his phone with both thumbs, his whole face lifted in a broad open smile, his cheeks high and his eyes bright, lit from below by the pale glow of the phone. A rail of crumpled clothes, a stack of takeaway boxes and a small skylight with a black sky behind it fill the room. The only light is the phone and a faint orange glow from a streetlamp through the skylight, the picture is grainy night-mode footage with lifted blacks and washed-out colour. Thanks.
